question: What are native llama.cpp prompt-processing and generation rates for the exact Ternary Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 GGUF at 8K through the largest prompt that fits its native 262144-token window?
decision_context: PrismML Bonsai already has Q172 75/100 with critical safety failures TC-74/84/92; do not repeat quality or consider adoption. This test only characterizes speed/context.

model.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 GGUF
model.metadata_read: GGUF v3 metadata parsed locally: qwen35.context_length=262144

profile.omit_524288: User instruction: discard 512K as too slow; no request will be issued.

method.harness: pinned PrismML llama-bench; native runtime measurement
method.runs: one context per process, serial; 8K x3, all larger levels x1; no warmup; JSON stdout saved verbatim
method.argv_pattern: llama-bench --model <verified GGUF> --device CUDA0,CUDA1 --split-mode layer --tensor-split 1,1 --n-gpu-layers 99 --flash-attn on --batch-size 2048 --ubatch-size 512 --threads 16 --pg <prompt_tokens>,128 --repetitions <3 for 8192, otherwise 1> --no-warmup --output json
method.measurements: Use native llama-bench pp and tg results. Do not merge with client-observed llama-benchy/vLLM/NInfer cohorts. No quality/quality-speed composite from this run.

stop_conditions: native context metadata does not match the registered maximum
OOM, runtime crash, or output indicates only one GPU was selected
any existing external inference server or non-GUI compute process
quality_reference: Q172 Bonsai PrismML seed42: 75/100, 42/56; critical failures TC-74, TC-84, TC-92; no further quality seed.
